commit_policy: Feature work happens on its own feature branch.
Feature development may include multiple commits, but the feature must end with at least one clear feature commit plus verification evidence.
Only stage files inside the feature commit_scope.
Do not use git add . or git commit -a for feature work in this harness.
Completed feature branches merge into the integration branch before release-gate and artifact export.

features.title: Harness Bootstrap And Progress Control
features.goal: Create the scheduler_AandW harness, lock version/output rules, and make the work resumable.
acceptance: scheduler_AandW contains app_spec.txt, feature_list.json, claude-progress.txt, init.sh, README.md, case_catalog.yaml, run_release_gate.py, reports/RESULT_TEMPLATE.md
Harness records artifact naming and output directory rules for version 0.0.3
Harness status command reports the next unfinished feature
features.commit_rule: Commit only harness files for this feature.

features.title: A-Scheduler Runtime Entry And Module Wiring
features.goal: Make the A-machine scheduler center runnable as a real service, not just a service class.
acceptance: A dedicated scheduler runtime entry exists and can start the scheduler loop
Scheduler startup uses the intended PostgreSQL scheduler database URL
The scheduler runtime can be used as a Docker command entrypoint
current_findings: Current compose examples call python -m apps.scheduler.scheduler_service, but runtime wiring is not yet validated as the real production entry
verification: python -m compileall apps/scheduler apps/models apps/services configs

env SCHEDULER_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://scheduler:secret@postgres:5432/scheduler_db DATABASE_URL=sqlite:////tmp/ignored.db python -c "from apps.scheduler.main import resolve_database_url; print(resolve_database_url(None))"
result: Added apps.scheduler.main as the dedicated scheduler-center CLI entrypoint
Scheduler startup now resolves SCHEDULER_DATABASE_URL before DATABASE_URL
Scheduler loop now executes DB work on one thread with a single SQLAlchemy session

features.title: A-Scheduler PostgreSQL Schema And Connectivity
features.goal: Lock the scheduler-center schema and database behavior on the shared PostgreSQL scheduler database.
acceptance: scheduler_tasks and smart_cut_devices tables are created and read from PostgreSQL
No default SQLite path remains in the A-scheduler production path
Connection settings and startup checks are explicit
verification: python -m compileall apps/scheduler apps/models apps/services configs
result: Scheduler startup now bootstraps the PostgreSQL schema explicitly before entering the loop
Scheduler runtime fails fast when required scheduler tables are missing
Scheduler-center database selection remains explicit through SCHEDULER_DATABASE_URL

features.title: A-Machine Unified Deployment Compose
features.goal: Produce the actual A-machine deployment compose for business API/web + PostgreSQL + scheduler center.
acceptance: Unified compose is valid and references real Dockerfiles that exist in the repo
Business API uses its business database path intentionally
Scheduler center and API both connect to the same PostgreSQL scheduler database over Docker internal networking
verification: docker compose -f docker-compose.a-machine-unified.yml build api scheduler
docker compose -f docker-compose.a-machine-unified.yml up -d postgres api scheduler
result: Root-level docker-compose.a-machine-unified.yml now wires postgres, api, scheduler, and web on one internal network
API image builds from apps/api/Dockerfile with repo-local requirements
Scheduler service now has a real container command using python -m apps.scheduler.main
residual_risks: The compose file expects WEB_IMAGE to exist or defaults to website_aicut-web:admin; web image build remains an external prerequisite for fresh environments
current_findings: At least one compose example points to apps/api/Dockerfile.prod, which does not exist in the main repo

features.title: Worker Gateway Runtime And Startup Contract
features.goal: Turn Worker gateway into a clean machine-level runtime with stable startup behavior.
acceptance: Worker gateway starts and stays resident
Processor registration and main loop are part of the formal runtime path
Separated gateway architecture is favored over combined experimental mode
current_findings: Formal runtime entry now lives at python -m worker.main
Worker startup contract validates runtime config, registers processors explicitly, and drives the main loop through a single entrypoint
Gateway-only Dockerfile, entrypoint, and test compose now use the formal runtime path instead of the combined experimental image
features.commit_rule: Commit worker runtime entry, startup contract, and harness tracking only.

features.title: Worker Gateway PostgreSQL Integration
features.goal: Make Worker gateway read and write the shared A-machine PostgreSQL scheduler database.
acceptance: Worker gateway production path no longer defaults to SQLite
Gateway can register, heartbeat, and query assigned tasks against PostgreSQL
Runtime validation proves it against PostgreSQL, not only SQLite
current_findings: worker.main now requires DATABASE_URL to be set explicitly instead of defaulting the runtime path to SQLite
worker/docker-compose.test.yml now provisions PostgreSQL for the gateway-only runtime image
worker.core now verifies the shared PostgreSQL schema instead of creating tables or falling back to SQLite
verification: python -m worker.main --check  # expected failure when DATABASE_URL is unset
python verifier snippet inserting ASSIGNED SchedulerTask in PostgreSQL and confirming worker.find_assigned_task() returns it
features.commit_rule: Commit worker PostgreSQL runtime changes and harness tracking only.

features.title: Gateway-TOS Transport Ownership
features.goal: Implement the rule that Worker gateway owns all TOS download/upload for Smart-Cut execution.
acceptance: Gateway downloads all required task inputs from TOS into the shared work directory
Gateway uploads all declared outputs from the shared work directory to TOS
Algorithm container does not require direct TOS credentials
result: Added worker.services.file_transport as the gateway-owned transport layer for download/upload
Gateway transport now supports bare TOS keys, fake:// download URLs, http(s) presigned URLs, and local paths
Analyze processor now accepts current payload fields original_video_tos_key and reference_text_tos_key
Preview and finalize processors now delegate file movement to the shared gateway transport path

features.title: Gateway-Algorithm Shared Directory Contract
features.goal: Define and implement the shared-directory contract between Worker gateway and the Smart-Cut algorithm image.
acceptance: task_manifest.json contract is fixed
result_manifest.json contract is fixed
Shared directory layout under /data/worker-jobs/{task_id} is fixed

features.title: Gateway Docker Runner For Algorithm Image
features.goal: Make Worker gateway launch the Smart-Cut algorithm image per task/stage instead of embedding scheduler logic into the algorithm image.
acceptance: Gateway starts the algorithm container with mounted work directory
Gateway waits for exit status and reads result_manifest.json
Gateway can map stages to algorithm-container command lines deterministically

features.title: Analyze End-to-End Through Shared PostgreSQL
features.goal: Run analyze from A scheduler center through Worker gateway to algorithm image and back.
acceptance: A scheduler assigns analyze task in PostgreSQL
Worker gateway picks it up and executes algorithm container
Outputs are uploaded to TOS and scheduler state advances correctly

features.title: Preview End-to-End Through Shared PostgreSQL
features.goal: Run preview through the full A-machine + Worker gateway + algorithm chain.
acceptance: Gateway executes preview container with manifest inputs
audio_b and preview manifests are produced and uploaded
Business task and scheduler task state close correctly

features.title: Finalize End-to-End Through Shared PostgreSQL
features.goal: Run finalize through the full A-machine + Worker gateway + algorithm chain.
acceptance: Gateway executes finalize container with manifest inputs
final_video and optional GroundTruth outputs are uploaded
Final task state and worker release are correct

features.title: Heartbeat Timeout And Recovery
features.goal: Prove offline detection and task recovery across the shared scheduler database.
acceptance: Offline workers are marked offline by A-scheduler
Their assigned tasks are reset to pending
Recovery behavior is verified with PostgreSQL-backed runs

features.title: Artifact Build And Version Recording
features.goal: Create repeatable build/export flows for A-scheduler and Worker gateway images with versioned filenames.
acceptance: Image tar outputs land in /Volumes/XIAOMA-A-1T/docker_hub/WorkerGateway_and_Ascheduler
Filenames follow version 0.0.3 plus timestamp naming
Harness artifacts record component name, version, timestamp, commit, and path

features.title: Release Gate
features.goal: Verify the full A-machine scheduler center + Worker gateway architecture and record release evidence.
acceptance: A-scheduler, PostgreSQL, Worker gateway, and algorithm image all run together
Core stage flows pass end-to-end
A release report is generated under the harness reports directory
